title: G-CNN task-conditional Mirror exception
amendment: 01 synthetic C4 task orbit and non-orbit exception
scope: Mechanism-only synthetic image screen; tests exact transformed-copy tasks versus one genuinely non-orbit task.
hypothesis: A two-bit task phase coordinate over one exactly C4-equivariant representation can serve group-related logical functions with fewer bytes than independent task heads; a non-orbit task may require private residual parameters.
physical_object: One shared convolutional feature extractor lifted to an exact C4 orbit representation by evaluating the same CNN on four rotations.
mirror_coordinate: Task phase m_t selects a cyclic relabeling of the four orientation-feature slots; optional private residual for the non-orbit task.
logical_multiplicity: Task0/Task1 are exact C4-related orientation decisions; Task2 is an object-class decision outside that orbit.
prior_art_controls: native shared exact C4 orbit representation with independent task heads
Mirror shared head + fixed phase codes, no private residual
Mirror phase + private residual for task2
ordinary learned task gate over group slots

development.selection_metric: Implementation smoke only; no hyperparameter selection.

metrics: exact C4 feature equivariance max error
success_gate: On all fresh seeds, phase view retains ≥95% native task0/task1 accuracy with ≤60% of native-head payload; private residual must restore task2 within 5 percentage points.
failure_gate: Phase view misses task0/task1 accuracy or is matched by ordinary gate at equal/fewer bytes; classify no Mirror-specific gain. Report non-orbit task private-state frontier separately.
boundaries: Task0 and Task1 are exact transformed copies and do not count as independent capacity.
Task2 is a distinct non-orbit class decision; passing does not establish general task multiplicity.
Group orbit is an exact reindexing and may be equivalent to a task-specific head or gate.
No natural-image dataset or broad G-CNN claim.
